ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) against 85% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity field with sparse, high-intensity linear streaks distributed across both lobes; localized high-intensity focal patches on the right-lobe distal margin and extreme tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an estimated 45-degree angle of convergence at the central axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entirety of the trailing edge; amplitude increases significantly at the lateral tips due to external biological growth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch extending to the distal tips, following a roughly symmetrical upward arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured brownish-white clusters localized on the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of macro-parasitic colonization or encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense, multi-directional network of high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring (rake marks) and heavy barnacle encrustations concentrated on the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Water turbulence and spray occlude the central-bottom portion of the fluke-to-peduncle transition.
